protocol.eligibility: Freeze all native/zero observations before any nonzero edit. A binding layout is eligible only when the model answers both Dax and Neri correctly in the native codeword-only format (whitespace/case/terminal punctuation/quote-markdown normalization, EOS). Preserve failed pairs and no-activation cases. Lexical cases are observation-only, not causal tests.
protocol.intervention: At every supplied input token, subtract the natural L29 T2375 gate times the local operator from the native MLP output. Preserve all supplied text and all other native computation. Generated/candidate-continuation tokens unedited. FP32 edit followed by one BF16 cast.
protocol.probabilities: Sum disjoint exact complete water/oil output-token prefixes over lowercase/titlecase with zero/one leading space, deduplicated by token sequence. Input is never retokenized. Preserve word-plus-EOS separately. A water prefix can be followed by more text; do not interpret it as semantic water or a word-boundary event in lexical controls.
protocol.controls: Counterbalance fluid assignment and fact order; ask both names natively before eligibility; water/watermelon/Waterloo/waterloo same-carrier observation with input token spans; original raw month 11/12 technical calibration. No matched active-transform specificity control in this pilot.
